About the price. EUR 150 covers the design and the hand-drawing. If I source the sneaker for you, the shoe price is added on top. Shipping is calculated per destination via bpost and shown before you confirm. Orders outside the EU may have import duties, which I flag clearly at checkout.

02 / The maker

Seven years of ink, one pair at a time.

What started as drawing on my own sneakers for fun became something friends kept asking for. After designs that faded or bled in the rain, I rebuilt the whole process: the materials, the sealing, the finish, until every line stayed permanent.

Balenciaga once sold deliberately destroyed sneakers, scuffed and falling apart, for over EUR 1.500, and a leather tote shaped like a bin bag for almost as much. People pay that to stand out. Kustomized turns that around. A real artwork, made with you, that actually carries your story.
